description: Unit test class for object pool allocation, recycling, and resource management in Orleans runtime streams.

classes.name: ObjectPoolTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for object pool behavior including allocation, recycling, and resource management.

classes.name: Accumulator
classes.description: Tracks current and maximum number of allocated resources during tests.

classes.name: TestPooledResource
classes.description: A pooled resource class that updates the accumulator on allocation and reset.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets the resource state, decreasing the current allocation count and increasing the allocation count.

methods.name: Alloc1Free1Test
methods.description: Tests that allocating and freeing a resource results in a maximum of one resource allocated at a time.

methods.name: Alloc10Free1Test
methods.description: Tests pre-allocation of 10 resources and verifies max allocated count remains 10 after repeated allocations and frees.

methods.name: ReuseResourceTest
methods.description: Tests resource reuse and correct tracking of maximum allocations over multiple cycles.
